title: PAH-OMC-006 nonzero-Q matter-density cylinder compatibility
question: Does the unchanged PAH-001 midpoint generator have exact rootwise compatibility for a nontrivial matter-density cylinder under the stable G_2 -> G_3 geometric strip inclusion, while exposing the preceding G_1 -> G_2 boundary defect?
method: Create the separately hashed researcher-owned PAH-OMC-006 contract without modifying PAH-001, PAH-OMC-004 or PAH-OMC-005.
Use the genuine two-row diagonal strip and compare only the neutral inclusion G_2 -> G_3, where the endpoint closure of h00, v0 and d0 is interior to the newly split frontier.
Enumerate every K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, Q=1 patch state with one radial quantum at a,b,c or d and neutral remote coordinates.
Evaluate the full displayed PAH functional before and after every directed radial-transfer root incident to a, retaining endpoint onsite, edge, covariant and Wilson contributions.
Compare the complete rootwise tuple (state, edge, source, target, DeltaF, mobility squared, Delta ell_a, midpoint exponent) by exact rational arithmetic and a canonical digest.
Run an independently rebuilt lane, hostile mutations and a Lean finite arithmetic cross-check; separately replay G_1 -> G_2 as a boundary-control defect rather than extending the proposition.
finding: All 32,768 states and 49,152 directed anchor-incident radial roots agree exactly between G_2 and G_3. The primary lane passes 20/20, the non-importing independent lane 12/12, hostile review rejects 9/9 mutations, integrated verification passes 18/18 and Lean R486 compiles. The common row digest is 716610a6a4694d963e079d4c890ce355f995add1f5f3ad12241f6ce7c2ce35eb. The G_1 -> G_2 control has DeltaF 0 versus -1 for h00:b->a, so the first boundary is explicitly not stable.
decision_reason: R-485 covered only an anchor-aperture cylinder. This separately hashed finite successor tests a genuinely matter-dependent cylinder with the unchanged radial-transfer roots, proves exact rootwise equality on the first stable interior comparison, and records the prior boundary failure instead of extrapolating across it.
evidence_level: T0 finite exact nonzero-Q matter-cylinder replay with primary, non-importing independent, hostile, integrated and Lean verification

source_authorities.role: immutable functional, moves, mobility and rate source

assumptions: PAH-001, PAH-OMC-004 and PAH-OMC-005 remain byte-identical at their pinned hashes.
PAH-OMC-006 is a finite researcher proposal using the unchanged displayed couplings and midpoint rate.
The neutral inclusion retains all G_2 coordinates and adds only zero-charge, neutral remote coordinates.
The radial observable ell_a is gauge neutral and the declared anchor automorphism group is the identity.
G_2 and G_3 have identical endpoint interaction closure for the h00, v0 and d0 roots; G_1 -> G_2 is treated only as a checked boundary control.
missing_assumptions: A total gauge-equivariant refinement map for arbitrary matter, link and radial cylinders.
A common invariant algebra and source-authorized root multiplicity theorem beyond this finite cylinder.
A regulator-, volume- and source-uniform interaction estimate and convergence theorem in the inherited ordered limit.
boundary: Finite local compatibility only. The result does not close T-054, does not change any canonical gate or claim tier, and does not establish an infinite-volume generator, uniform limit, physical sector, Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass gap or TOE conclusion.
next_action: Construct one separately hashed multi-cylinder common-core packet, including a link cylinder and a second interior matter anchor, and test whether a single root-support envelope survives without changing PAH-001.
revisit_condition: Reopen the uniform lane only when multiple-cylinder root transport, nonzero-Q state transport beyond this fixture, a common invariant core and a regulator/volume-uniform bound are explicitly supplied.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion.
No retroactive modification or completion of PAH-001, PAH-OMC-001, PAH-OMC-003, PAH-OMC-004 or PAH-OMC-005.
The G_2 -> G_3 equality is a finite local result and the G_1 -> G_2 defect is not a global no-go.
